description: The consulted legacy manual is a 2015 codebook extract. The current official MM baseline/version, full coding procedure, dataset-wide unit coverage and terms are not verified. No candidate is an official MM event or ID.
required_followup: Coordinator verifies the authoritative current baseline/version, codebook and country-month ownership before consolidation.

description: Ten native search invocations were captured with 293 result headers across general Spanish/English, week, sector, regional and focused queries. Search result counts are not complete event coverage; no LexisNexis or equivalent licensed archive was accessed. The evidence supports candidates and explicit leads, not an absence claim for Colombia in January.
required_followup: Review country news archives and any licensed/protest-monitoring databases; expand only with exact captured queries and source provenance.

description: Attendance is not reported in opened sources for the Jan25–31 La Mojana strike, the Oponcito/Campo 23 block, or La Lizama humanitarian action. Search-only snippets have turnout claims for Santander páramo farmers and Bogotá recyclers, but those claims are not body-verified. Several Bogotá actions also lack any count. Vehicles, blocked roads, affected commuters and affected communities are not participant counts.
required_followup: Find a count scoped to each distinct physical action or retain pending_threshold/pending_evidence. Do not transfer turnout between episodes or locations.

description: One exact-URL web.open attempt for each of S001, S004, S005, S009, S015, S019, S020, S021, S030, S034 and S035 returned a Cache miss with no HTTP status or page body. Each attempt has a fresh access receipt and is recorded as a technical retrieval failure, not as a publisher denial. No repeated opens were made after the initial failures.
required_followup: If a source is retried, obtain a new exact-URL access receipt and recheck its exact unit card, alias and origin first; otherwise seek accessible independent reporting.

description: The El Oponcito/Campo 23 license protest has conflicting timing: opened Vanguardia says roughly 48 hours by Jan25 while a Caracol search excerpt says the community had been at the point since Jan08. Search-only coverage also reports Jan25 solidarity blockades at Puerto Wilches and Sabana de Torres. It is unclear whether these are phases, separate groups, or distinct physical episodes.
required_followup: Read direct source bodies and map each site/group/date separately; keep all actions unmerged until the physical boundaries and crowd evidence are clear.

description: The Wayuu blockade report describes a crowd as “hundreds” but also reports a dispute over whether organizers had authority to represent all affected Wayuu communities. Jan23 is inferred from wording that the protest was already in its second day on Jan24; the agreement/road clearance is dated Jan25.
required_followup: Verify the start date, turnout by site, organizing authorization and scope/implementation of the reported T-302-related agreement.

description: Reported agreements or dialogue commitments exist for La Mojana, the Wayuu blockades, La Lizama, Santander páramo farmers and recyclers. These are not evidence of completed policy/work implementation. Radio Nacional is an RTVC public broadcaster; its account does not independently verify government performance.
required_followup: Check primary government/municipal records or independent reporting for exact commitments, parties and later implementation; keep unobserved response fields unknown.

description: The Jan16 Bogotá youth action is documented only in search text and concerns allegations about disappearances during the 2021 strike; neither the allegation nor the precise 2023 demand is body-verified. Other search-only leads about platform drivers may refer to a planned Ministry meeting rather than a physical protest.
required_followup: Read direct bodies to verify what occurred, the state target, the organizers and the public demand. Determine whether platform-driver items report an actual protest or only planned dialogue before creating a separate candidate.
